assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D pixel-art game asset on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. Create ONE dramatic wind spirit enemy, full body centered, no other subjects, no text. It is a menacing supernatural tornado made of dark navy, charcoal and desaturated steel-blue smoke with a clearly readable fierce human-like face emerging from the upper cloud mass. Angular brows, narrow pale ivory eyes, shadowy cheekbones and a snarling shadow mouth, eerie but suitable for a child adventure game. Large broad swirling shoulders taper to a curling narrow tornado tip. Several crisp layered smoke ribbons, intricate pixel-shaded turbulent volume and sweeping wisps. Small flying tan papers and dark stone flecks orbit the body. Rich hand-drawn 16-bit/32-bit pixel art, visibly stepped edges, restrained highlights, no smooth vector shapes, no simple geometric emoji face. Strong clean silhouette, beautiful detailed game sprite. Exactly one complete creature with a generous transparent margin on all sides. No arms or legs, no lightning, no electricity, no blue energy bolts, no fire, no scenery, no backdrop or ground shadow. The creature will be displayed about 300 pixels tall in a side-view combat game. The face looks slightly toward screen-left. Portrait composition.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit/reference image: the attached combat sprite sheet defines the exact youthful characters, outfits, proportions, pixel shading and side-view game style to preserve. Produce a NEW clean sprite strip with EXACTLY THREE full-body characters, one per equal-width column, on a genuinely transparent background. LEFT: Jason, blond teen in purple T-shirt, jeans and sneakers, leaning forward into a single right-handed golden sword thrust toward screen-right, free hand empty behind him. CENTER: Piper, long dark brown hair, purple jacket, white shirt, jeans and purple sneakers, lunging with a wooden club toward screen-right. RIGHT: Leo, curly dark hair and brass goggles, olive-green open jacket, white shirt, tool belt, ripped jeans and sneakers, lunging with a short steel-headed workshop hammer toward screen-right. Match the reference quick-strike poses and consistent character sizes, crisp pixel art. Wide landscape composition. Each sprite must be ENTIRELY isolated inside its OWN column with a large transparent gap between columns. Same foot baseline for all three, identical head scale. Include full weapons and both feet entirely. Exactly TWO legs and TWO arms per character. No extra limbs, no pieces from neighboring poses, no other poses, no labels, no text, no effects, no colored backgrounds, no ground shadows. Use only these three complete attacking figures with clear padding from all image boundaries.
